### Q1
No. The store stays a plain-text JSON file (data/store.json) and does not move to SQLite or node:sqlite. Ops's nightly rsync job diffs plain-text files, and a binary DB would break their backup checks. The performance fix is debounced writes (200 ms window).

### Q2
Yes, src/legacy/ must never be modified. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's sync job overwrites the folder every Monday, so any change would be silently lost.

### Q3
The signature goes in the JSON body as a top-level `sig` field. It is a hex HMAC-SHA256 over the body without `sig`, using the secret in ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET. We first tried an X-Signature header and deployed it to staging. The ERP's API gateway strips all custom X- headers, so every webhook arrived unsigned.

### Q4
Port 9911, since the October infra move. docs/erp-api.md and README still say 8080, which is stale.

### Q5
Every new user-facing error `message` must be in German, because warehouse packers see it verbatim. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

### Q6
It uses a hardcoded list of Austrian public holidays for 2026 and 2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, with no holiday API. The warehouse deployment has no outbound internet, so it has to work fully offline.

### Q7
No. Batching (an array of up to 50 events per POST) was tried in September 2026, and the ERP answers 422 to any array payload. It accepts only one event object per request.

### Q8
No new npm dependencies, runtime or dev. Each new package needs a security review that takes about 6 weeks.

### Q9
Yes, and it is a dead end. QA found that a memoized version served stale ETAs after a new event such as an exception, because the cache wasn't invalidated. A proper cache key got messy. A later measurement showed calculateEta is only about 2 ms of a 500-item list, so there is nothing to gain. The plan is to paginate GET /shipments later instead.

### Q10
There are at most 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s delay and no exponential backoff. Retries happen on network errors or 5xx responses. The ERP dedupes by event_id only within a 2-minute window, so all attempts must land inside it or the ERP gets duplicate events. The delay must be injectable for tests.

### Q11
Never log the recipient's name, address or phone, anywhere, for GDPR reasons (the data protection officer flagged it in an audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are fine to log. The request log may contain only method, path, status and duration_ms, with no query string and no bodies.

### Q12
Yes, 'emits webhook on delivered' in test/events.test.ts. It fails about 1 in 5 runs on CI because of a timer race in the fake notifier (tracked as OPS-412, owned by the platform team). If it fails, rerun once and don't try to fix it.

### Q13
Only carrier ATP gets UPU S10 check-digit validation (the algorithm is in docs/carriers.md). All other carriers accept any non-empty value. Their formats change often, and last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for two days.

### Q14
Hot reload is a later task, not for now. fs.watch never fires on staging, because the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host and change events don't propagate into the container. fs.watchFile (polling) worked, so use polling.

### Q15
Yes, GET /shipments/:id must stay exactly as is, with no added or removed fields. The mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown or missing fields, and the next mobile release is January 2027. `eta` is added only to the GET /shipments list items.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker
<!-- gemkeeper ledger. Written for the next session. Keep it under ~120 lines. Edit in place. -->
Updated: 2026-11-17

## Mission
- Work on parcel-tracker (shipment tracking service, Vienna warehouse; Node 24 runs TS directly, no build step, zero deps). Task 1: calculateEta (src/services/eta.ts) must skip Austrian public holidays, not just weekends; add tests + run them.
- User works autonomously-style: reviews everything at the end (user).

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites the folder every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- (user) No new npm dependencies, not even devDependencies — each new package needs security review (~6 weeks).

## Decisions
- (user) Tracking-number validation: ONLY carrier ATP gets UPU S10 check-digit validation (algorithm in docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value — because their formats change often and last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for two days.
- (user) Austrian public holidays = hardcoded list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts, no holiday API — because the warehouse deployment has no outbound internet; must work fully offline.

## Rules (cont.)
- (user) NEVER log recipient name, address or phone, anywhere (GDPR; data protection officer flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK to log. Request log (Router.handle in src/router.ts): method, path, status, duration_ms only — no query string, no bodies; test/request-log.test.ts guards it.
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must stay EXACTLY as is (no added/removed fields) — mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on unknown/missing fields; next mobile release is January 2027. `eta` is added only to GET /shipments list items (done in the list handler, shipmentToApi untouched; test guards the :id key set). Don't touch shipmentToApi in a way that changes :id.
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (shown verbatim to warehouse packers); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.

## Facts
- `npm start` = node src/server.ts; `npm test` = node --test (files in test/). Env: PORT, DATA_FILE, ERP_URL; config/default.json.
- (user) Test 'emits webhook on delivered' (test/events.test.ts) is flaky (~1 in 5 on CI, timer race in fake notifier), tracked OPS-412, owned by platform team: if it fails, rerun once, do NOT try to fix it.
- .gemkeeper/ is not in .gitignore (open question below).

- Perf measured 2026-11-17 on 5k synthetic shipments in-process: GET /shipments = 5 ms (limit 50) / 14 ms (limit 500, 121 KB); calculateEta is only ~2 ms of that (500 items) → memoizing it was NOT built (user asked; gain negligible, adds stale-ETA risk since ETA depends on status+events). If staging is really slow, profile there (store file I/O? network? data shape) before optimizing.

## Facts (ERP)
- ERP webhook signing: `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 (secret env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET) over JSON body WITHOUT the `sig` field, sent as top-level `sig` in the body (src/services/notify.ts, src/config.ts). Unset secret → unsigned + one warning (my choice; rollout ERP-1182).
- ERP payload field names FIXED (user asked): notify.ts now sends `event_type`/`occurred_at` as in docs/erp-api.md (old `type`/`at` only accepted until 2026-12-31). Test in test/notify-signature.test.ts pins them. docs/erp-api.md is owned by the ERP team: do NOT edit it (user).
- (user) ERP sandbox now listens on port 9911 (since the October infra move), NOT 8080 as docs/erp-api.md and README say (doc is stale; user fixes README themself). config/default.json erp.url still says loc
